description.zh: 函数内存规格，取值为64的倍数，至少128MB，至多2048MB。
description.en: Memory specification for the function. The value must be a multiple of 64, with a minimum of 128 MB and a maximum of 2048 MB.

description.zh:
函数名称。
函数名称长度在1-30个字符间，只能包含字母、数字、下划线和中划线，不能以数字、中划线开头。

> 云函数的名称必须和要上传的Node.js代码包名称一致。
description.en:
The function name.  
The name must be 1 to 30 characters long and can contain only letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It cannot start with a digit or a hyphen.

> The name of the cloud function must match the name of the Node.js code package to be uploaded.

description.zh: 云函数执行环境，默认值为nodejs14，可选值为nodejs12,nodejs14等，详情参见文档[《运行时支持列表》](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2717618.html)。
description.en: Execution runtime of the cloud function. The default value is nodejs14. Valid values include nodejs12, nodejs14, and others. For more information, see the document [Runtime Support List](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2717618.html).

description.zh: 云函数所属的服务空间ID。
description.en: The ID of the service space to which the cloud function belongs.

description.zh: 函数超时时间，单位为秒，默认值为5，取值范围1-7200。
description.en: The function timeout, in seconds. Default value is 5. Valid values range from 1 to 7200.
